item.title: Tecnologo: Public Competition No. 2026S31, based on examinations. The competition is intended to recruit No. 1 Second-level Research Technologist, who will be hired under a fixed-term, part-time employment contract for 18 hours per week for 24 months (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 14:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova

The position to be filled involves carrying out the following activities: • Management of the technological infrastructure for the PersoNa (Personal Narratives in Climate Litigation) project: - Design, installation, configuration and maintenance of the infrastructure, - Support for the development and application of text mining techniques, - Collaboration with statisticians and other IT specialists within the research team, - Support for the development of machine learning models for text mining to analyse judicial decisions.

item.title: Tecnologo: European Alliance SUNRISE - OIP026 - Project code 101177279 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The Tecnologo/Tecnologa will primarily support the design, development, and maintenance of the SUNRISE Alliance IT infrastructure, as well as data collection and analysis and other activities related to the project’s work packages. The main focus will be on supporting innovation and knowledge transfer to the local territory, as outlined in Work Packages WP4 and WP5.
